mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.shop_id, v.title, v.sub_title, v.rules, v.pay_value, v.actual_value, v.type, v.status FROM tb_voucher v WHERE v.shop_id = #{shopId} AND v.status = 1 AND v.type = 0 ORDER BY v.id DESC

SELECT v.id, v.shop_id, v.title, v.sub_title, v.rules, v.pay_value, v.actual_value, v.type, v.status, sv.begin_time, sv.end_time, v.create_time, v.update_time FROM tb_voucher v INNER JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON v.id = sv.voucher_id WHERE v.shop_id = #{shopId} AND v.status = 1 AND v.type = 1 AND sv.end_time > NOW() ORDER BY sv.begin_time ASC, v.id DESC

SELECT v.id, v.shop_id, v.title, v.sub_title, v.rules, v.pay_value, v.actual_value, v.type, v.status, sv.stock, sv.begin_time, sv.end_time FROM tb_voucher v LEFT JOIN tb_seckill_voucher sv ON sv.voucher_id = v.id WHERE v.shop_id = #{shopId} ORDER BY v.id DESC
